name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Are you ready to get started with the first secret of American English pronunciation?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Let's start.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Have you heard this phrase before?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: "The early bird catches the worm."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This means that if you wake up early or you get started now, well, you will succeed.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Only the birds that wake up early in the morning get the best worms.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: If you wait, if you procrastinate, well, too bad for you.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You won't be able to succeed.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: But this wonderful phrase uses an important American English pronunciation point.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: There are three words, early, bird and worm that use a colored R. So in American English,

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: this R is a strong hard sound, early, bird, worm.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Do you see how that's almost like an angry dog?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Worm, bird, early.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Make sure that when you're using American English pronunciation, this colored R sound

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: is hard.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Phrase number two that uses a key American English pronunciation is this one.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Have you ever heard someone say, "Your guess is as good as mine?"

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Your guess is as good as mine.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This means that the other person has no clue.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Maybe you could say, "I don't know how to get to the beach.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Your guess is as good as mine."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: But there is something important happening with the pronunciation of this phrase.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: At the end of the word guess, and at the end of the word is, there is an S. But in American

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: English pronunciation, we often link the S with the vowel next to make a Z sound.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: So listen carefully when I say this phrase, "Your guess is as good as mine."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: It sounds a lot like this, and that's what's happening here.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We are linking together the S plus a vowel from the next word.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Try to say it with me.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Your guess is as good as mine.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I have no clue.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Your guess is as good as mine.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Key phrase number three that uses American English pronunciation is this fun one, "Don't

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: bite the hand that feeds you."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Have you ever been trying to help someone and then they complain about how you're helping

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: them?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You can use this phrase and say, "Hey, don't bite the hand that feeds you.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I'm just trying to help you."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Well, it's the same idea.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: If you argue with your boss, if you yell at your boss, ugh, he's the one that gives you

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: your paycheck.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: So don't bite the hand that feeds you.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: But there is an important American English pronunciation here that happens three times.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Don't, bite, and then a little later in the sentence is the word that.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: What is similar between all three of these words?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: It's the letter T. Listen when I say this contraction, "Don't, don't."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Do you hear, "Don't" with that puff of air coming out?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Nope.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: In American English, oftentimes a T at the end of words will be cut off.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We call this a stopped T because your mouth is making that shape.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: "Don't."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: My tongue is at the top of my mouth trying to make that T shape, but there's no puff

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: of air that comes out.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Listen carefully as I say this, and I want you to hear that stopped T. "Don't bite the

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: hand that feeds you."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: All right, let's go to our next phrase.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Has this ever happened to you before?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You invite a lot of people over to your house and you think, "It's going to be a fun party.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: It's great."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: And then it just becomes so many people in your house, so much chaos, and you have to

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: say this, "Oh, no, I think it's going to get out of hand."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This doesn't mean that anything is really in your hand and it's getting out of your

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: hand.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Instead, this means it's getting out of control.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: But this phrase, "Get out of hand," uses an important American English pronunciation tip,

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: which is that the T at the end of words, another T tip, that has a vowel next often changes

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: to a D sound.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: So listen, when I say this, "The party will get out of hand."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The word get is surrounded by vowels.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: There's a vow on either side, G-E-T, and then the next word starts with an O. So that T

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: is surrounded by vowels, and that means that it's going to change to a D sound.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: "Get out," and then it's going to happen with out and of.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: "Out of."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: In fact, the word of changes to just a.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Get out of hand.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Can you say it with me?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: All right, let's go to our last American English pronunciation tip.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Has it ever happened to you that you travel abroad and then you realize that you are just

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: meeting people from your own home country?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: It's like you're magnetic towards each other.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Well, we could use this phrase, "Birds of a feather flock together," and this means

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: that common things are attracted to each other for better or for worse.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: So there is a key American English pronunciation point we can talk about with this phrase.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We already talked about the word bird and how it uses that colored R, that hard R sound.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Bird.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: And there is another R tip in this phrase as well.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Can you say this wonderful idiom with me?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: "Birds of a feather flock together."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Wonderful.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: So if you can use all five of these American English pronunciation points, you will sound

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: "You are hospitable.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Nice, friendly."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: But here's a big warning.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: If you come from France, Italy, Spain, Brazil, Portugal, these romantic language countries,

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: do not.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Warning, warning, warning.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Do not say, sympathetic.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You do not say, "He is sympathetic.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: She is sympathetic."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This does not mean nice in English.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This is a false friend and I hear a lot of people say this.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Instead, in English, we do have the word sympathetic.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This means that maybe your brother lost his job.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: And when you go over to his house, you bring him some flowers and you bring him a meal

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: and you sit down and talk with him, and you talk about that difficult, hard time in his

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: life.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Because, you are sympathetic to his difficulty.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We usually have a difficult situation happening and you didn't personally experience that

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: difficult thing, but you feel his difficulty.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You feel his pain.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You are sympathetic.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: So here we're using it in a completely different sense than friendly.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Friendly just means, you're nice.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: But if someone has a difficult situation, you are sympathetic to their problem.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You understand.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: "Oh, I think my brother's really sad right now.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: He's probably worried about the future."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You are understanding his difficult times.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I hope I explained this word as sympathetic, so that you do not use it and say, "Vanessa,

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: you are so sympathetic."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: No, no, no, no, no.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Don't use that.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: All right.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: What are some other words we can use?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You could say, "I'm compassionate.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I'm considerate.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I'm generous."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This means you give maybe your time or your money to other people.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You could say, "I'm warm.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I'm warm-hearted."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This means that people feel this warm feeling when they're with you.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: They feel like you're such a friendly person.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You could say, "I'm helpful.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I'm down to earth."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Down to earth is an expression that we use to mean you are relatable.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: People feel like your life is not so different from theirs.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: But maybe there is one celebrity who relates to the problems of normal people.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Someone might say, "Oh yeah, she's really down to earth.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: But before we go, I'd like to share some extra material with you today.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I'm going to show you a little bit around the farm so you'll get some real practice

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: with these expressions.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The two expressions that we're going to talk about today are to get to do something and

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: to have to do something.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Today, you're going to get to guess some of the wonderful vegetation that's around me

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: on this farm.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I'm going to take you on a little tour throughout this lesson, and I want you to guess what

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: the different plants are.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Let's talk about that first expression, to get to do something.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This expression has a sense of honor, of privilege, kind of a sense of, wow, I get to be in this

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: beautiful nature.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Wow, I'm so privileged.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I feel honored to be here.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You could just use the simple past or the simple present.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I am in beautiful nature, but if we want to give a sense of honor, privilege, wow, I'm

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: so lucky to be here, we can use get to.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I get to be in this beautiful nature.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: What about that second expression, to have to do something?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Well, in order to get to this farm, we had to drive on some difficult roads.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: They weren't always paved.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: There were a lot of potholes.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: They were really windy.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We had to drive on difficult roads.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: When we use had to, which is the past version of have to, this has a sense of something

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: difficult, something undesirable.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I had to take out the trash.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I had to study for my exam.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: It's something that's a little bit of a burden, so here we have a positive expression, I get

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: to see beautiful nature.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We got to see amazing iguanas on the trail, or something negative, we had to drive on

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: some difficult roads to get here.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We had to pay $15 to get into the park.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Before I tell you a little story about my experience here in Costa Rica, let's go to

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: our first question where you get to guess some of the plants around the farm.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: All right, first quiz question.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We have this beautiful tree with these interesting things hanging down.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Can you guess what this is?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: What kind of plant is this?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You've got three seconds.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Three, two, one.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: It is cacao.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This is the outside seed, the outside pod, where you'll find chocolate.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I hope you enjoyed that first little quiz question.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: There's going to be three different quiz questions throughout this lesson.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Let me tell you a little story about the first night that we arrived in this city.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: When we got to the farm, the farmer helped us to find the house that we were staying

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: at.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: It's a little bungalow, a little cabin on his property, and when he tried to open the

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: gate, he couldn't open it.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: He tried one key, then he tried another, and he ran back to his farm, and we had to wait

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: for about 15 minutes while he looked for the key.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Then he came back with a key.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: He was so excited.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: He tried to open the gate, and it didn't work.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Well, he said, "You're probably going to have to wait for another hour while we work out

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: this problem with the key."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: For a moment, I was just a little bit worried, because we have a toddler, and we'd been driving

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: all day, so we wanted to just open the door and let him run free finally, but then he

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: said to us, "Well, we have a dinner available at our eating area.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Would you like to be our guest for dinner?"

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Yes, of course we would, so we got to have an amazing dinner at the farm.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We had some rice, and beans, and plantains, and chicken, and some guava juice, all produced

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: on the farm.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: It was our luck really, that we got to eat that dinner with them, because we had no plans

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: for dinner.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We were kind of worried what we were going to eat, because we just arrived here after

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: a long day of traveling.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Because of this problem with the key, he had to find the key somehow, somewhere, we got

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: to have a great experience.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Before we talk about the grammatical structure of get to and have to, let's go on to the

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: second quiz question.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Vanessa: The second quiz question.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Quiz question number two.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We've got these interesting plants here with these little flowers.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: What do you think these flowers will do someday when they're not flowers?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: What would they become?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: What will this plant produce?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Something quite important that probably a lot of you enjoy every day.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Let's take a look at these.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I'll give you three seconds.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Three, two, one.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: It's coffee.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This is a coffee plant.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The farm here has a lot of coffee.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: As you saw, also cacao, and we'll see a third one in just a moment.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Did you enjoy that second quiz question?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I hope so.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Let's talk about the grammatical structure of using "get" and "have" in the sense of

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: something positive or something negative happening.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We got to eat dinner on the farm.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: He had to look for the key.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Here, we're conjugating that special word, "get" and "have," into the past tense.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: And do you see what's happening after that?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We got to eat.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Make sure that you add "to" and then an unconjugated verb.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We got to eat.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: He had to look for the key.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Beautiful.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Now that you know how to correctly grammatically construct a sentence using "get to" and "have

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: to," let's go onto our third quiz question, and then I'll tell you a final story about

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: our trip using these beautiful expressions.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: For our third quiz question, it's quite obvious.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: So I want to show you the base of the tree first.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: And as we go up the tree, start thinking about what is it.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: What is this going to produce?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Here we can see a little flower hanging down.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: What is it?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: What is it?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Are you ready to guess?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Three, two, one.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: It's bananas.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: So beautiful.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I didn't know that so many grew in a bunch like that.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: It's wonderful.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I hope you enjoyed that third quiz question in this little mini tour of the farm.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: It's really nice to see nature in other areas around the world.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Now that you know what "get to" and "have to" mean, and you know the correct grammatical

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: structure, let me tell you another quick story about something that we did today and something

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: that we plan to do in the future so that you can see the different verb tenses, "forget"

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: and "have."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This morning, we got to see an amazing waterfall.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: It's one of the famous attractions of this area in Costa Rica.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: But to get to the waterfall, you have to walk down 500 steps.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: And then to go back to your car, you have to walk up 500 steps.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: But it was really cool because we got to see the waterfall, and then we walked a little

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: bit down the path and we got to really relax and feel refreshed and wade into the water.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: It was quite cold.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: There were a lot of fish.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: It was tons of fun.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: And a great part was we didn't have to drive too far from the farm.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: It was just about 15 minutes, so not too bad.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Over the next couple days, we hope that we'll get to see some more animals, maybe some sloths,

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: maybe some more monkeys and more iguanas, maybe an anteater or two, some parrots, maybe

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: some macaws.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: That would be amazing if we get to see those.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: So we're going to go to national park, and then we're going to maybe get to go to a hanging

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: bridge park.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Maybe we'll get to go to the lake.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We'll see.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: But you have to drive a little bit of a distance, maybe 30 minutes, an hour, an hour and a half

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: to get to those locations, but I think it'll be worth it.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We've already gotten to do a lot of cool stuff in Costa Rica, and I hope that we'll get to

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: do other cool things in the next couple days.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Great work.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I hope you enjoyed my little vacation to Costa Rica during that lesson.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The next grammar lesson is going to be focusing on an advanced grammar sentence construction

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: that I rarely see English learners use, but native speakers use this all the time.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I want to help you level up your speaking skills.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Let's watch.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Do you remember learning comparisons in your English classroom?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Like this sentence, "His bike is faster than my bike."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The word "faster" is a comparison word.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Or, "Her English is better than it was last year."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: "Better" is our comparison word.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: That picture is more beautiful than mine.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: "More beautiful" are our comparison words.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: When we have a short word like fast, hot, easy, green, we're just going to add "-er,"

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: faster, easier, hotter, greener.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: But when you have a longer word like that last sentence, beautiful or intelligent or

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: annoying, instead of adding "-er," we're just going to add "more" or "less."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: More beautiful, more intelligent, more annoying, less beautiful, less intelligent, less annoying.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: So these are our two ways that we can make comparisons just as a quick review because

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: that's going to be essential for taking it to the next level in our advanced sentence

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: structure.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Let's take a look at this sentence, "The warmer it is, the happier I feel."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Can you pick out the two comparison words here?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Warmer, happier.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We can see that "-er" at the end is kind of a key to this.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The warmer it is, the happier I feel.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Right now, it's the middle of winter where I live, but occasionally, every couple weeks,

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: there will be one day that feels like spring, and everyone in my city goes outside and jumps

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: for joy, and all of that sadness from winter just washes away because when it feels warm

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: outside, you feel great, you feel so happy.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: So we could use this sentence, "The warmer it is, the happier I feel."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We're comparing two things, but let's take a look at actually what's happening here.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We have those two comparison words, but what's happening right before that?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: It's the word "the."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The warmer it is, the happier I feel.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: So that's going to be our key here for structuring these sentences.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: At the beginning, we have some kind of cause.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The cause is warm weather.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: And what's the effect?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I feel happy.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: So we have a cause and effect happening here.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The warmer it is, the happier I feel.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Let's take a look at some other examples.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The richer the person, the more annoying he is.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This is just personal opinion.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: So here we have two comparison words, "richer" and "more annoying."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Because the word "annoying" is a longer word, we're going to use "more" in front of it instead

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: of saying "annoyinger."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We're not going to add "-er" at the end.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: And then we have that keyword, "the."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The richer the person is, or the richer the person, the more annoying he is.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: What about this one?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The sweeter the dessert, the more delicious it is.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: "The sweeter," that's our comparison word, "the more delicious," that's our other comparison

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: word, "it is."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: And we have "the" in front of both of those.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: So we have a cause and an effect.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The dessert is sweet.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: And what's the effect?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: It's more delicious.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We have a cause, someone is rich, and an effect, he's more annoying.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: So we have a cause and effect happening here with this wonderful advanced comparison.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Are you ready to take this to the next level?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You probably already know how to make comparison words, but what if we make this advanced concept

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: more advanced?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Often when we use "the," "the" sentence structure, like we've been talking about, we don't use

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: that comparison word.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We just use the word "more" or "less," plus a noun afterwards.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Let's take a look at this example.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The more you eat, the more you gain weight.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: "The more," that's our comparison.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: So we're not actually using a word like "the warmer" or "the more beautiful" or "the more

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: annoying."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We're not using those words.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Instead, we're just saying, "The more," plus a noun, "you."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The more you eat, the more you gain weight.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Let's look at a couple others.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The less I sleep, the less I can focus on my work.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We can use "more" or "less" in these situations.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: "The less I," that's our noun here, "I sleep, the less I can focus on my work."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The more I speak English, the more I feel comfortable.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Do you see in all of these sentences, we're just expanding on what you already know.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You know about comparisons, now you know that we need "the" in front of each of them, and

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: then we're adding "more" or "less."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The more I speak English, the more I feel comfortable.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We could switch that around and say, "the more comfortable I feel."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: There's a couple different ways you can use this, but this is going to be beautifully

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: advanced to talk about cause and effect, and we use this all the time.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: In fact, there are a couple fixed phrases.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: They're not exactly proverbs or idioms, but they're just fixed phrases that native speakers

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: use a lot that include this "the," "the" sentence structure.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Let's take a look at a couple.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Someone might ask you, "How do you like your coffee?"

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Well, you could say, "The stronger the better."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This means you don't like cream in it, you don't like sugar in it, you just want a lot

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: of caffeine.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Black coffee that's really strong with a lot of caffeine.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The stronger the better.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This is often used to talk about drinks.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You could even use it to talk about an alcoholic drink.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Do you want rum or vodka?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You might say, "I want both.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The stronger the better."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: So you're talking about the strength of the drink.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The other day, I was having a bonfire in my backyard and I invited a family, and they

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: said, "Hey, can I invite my other friends?"

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: And I said, "The more the merrier."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This is a really common "the," "the" type of fixed sentence.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The more people who come, the merrier.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This is kind of a old-fashioned word to mean happy.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The happier we will be.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: But in that fixed sentence structure, we do use the word "merrier" in daily conversation.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The more the merrier.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Sure, come on.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Or if you're having a problem at work and you're talking with your coworker, saying,

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: "Should we tell our boss about this problem?"

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Well, your coworker might say, "Well, the less said, the better."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The less said to our boss, the better the outcome or maybe the better for your boss

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: or the better for the situation.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The less said, the better.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The final common fixed phrase is one that procrastinators probably hear a lot.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Let's imagine that you need to study English or you want to study English, but you've looked

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: at your phone, you went for a walk, you called your friends, and then your husband says,

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: "Are you going to study your English lesson today?"

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: He might also say, "You know, the sooner you start, the sooner you finish."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: That phrase, "the sooner," "the sooner," is used a lot.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The sooner you begin exercising, the sooner you'll feel better.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The sooner you do something, if you do something now, you'll see the results quicker.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You'll see them sooner.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: So we often use this.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: And the sooner you start, the sooner you finish, or the sooner you'll see the results.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Now I'd like to share a quick conversation dialogue with you that uses this advanced

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: sentence structure a lot.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I challenge you, after this lesson, go back and try to say those sentences with us.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: That's going to train your speaking muscles, help with your pronunciation, and also remind

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: you how to use this because you're using it yourself.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I've been feeling kind of down lately, but I'm not sure why.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Dan: Have you been working too much again?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Vanessa: Well, I go to work at 6:00 AM and finish at

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: 8:00 PM, but that's fine with me.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Dan: Whoa, that's a long time.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Maybe the more you work, the more stressed you feel.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Vanessa: I don't know, I guess I have neglected to

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: see my friends lately.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Dan: Yeah, the more you see your friends, the more

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: positive you'll feel.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Vanessa: Yeah.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I do feel kind of lonely.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The less I do outside of work, the less connected I feel to them.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Yeah, maybe I have been working too much.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Dan: I'd say so.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Vanessa: In fact, the more I tell you about my work

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: life, the more I realize I need balance.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Dan: Yeah.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The more work, the more stress.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Vanessa: Yeah, the more down I feel.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Dan: But the more time with friends, the happier,

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: the more connected.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Vanessa: The more encouraged, but also the poorer.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Dan: What?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The poorer?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Vanessa: Yeah, because I would be spending money instead

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: of making money.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Dan: Don't worry about that.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The more money you make, the more you can spend.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Let's go have fun.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Vanessa: Okay, you convinced me.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Let's go.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Great work leveling up your speaking skills.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The next grammar lesson focuses on two tricky words, "do" versus "make."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You will join me in the woods again in nature.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Sometimes this helps make grammar a little more fun, where you're going to learn some

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: important expressions that can help you learn the difference between "do" and "make" in

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: your daily conversations.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Let's watch.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We use "do" for specific tasks, some obligations, or repetitive activities.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I need to do some housework.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This is an obligation, a duty, to do some housework.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We use "make" for creating or producing something.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I need to make some soup.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I'm creating the soup.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Today, we're going to be in two different locations, one in the woods and one by the

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: stream, so that you can visually remember the difference between these two words.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I hope that it will just add to this experience so that you can enjoy the lesson and also

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: remember these words.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: But this can be tricky because cooking meals is kind of an obligation or a duty, right?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I hope that by talking about some specific expressions with both of these words, it'll

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: help you to remember them, but also it'll help you to keep those words together.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: If you hear "make soup," "make soup," "make soup" a lot, your brain will keep these two

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: words together.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: It's kind of like when you were first starting to learn English, you never heard "I were

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: happy."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You always heard "I was happy."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Because you never heard "I were happy," you probably didn't create that wrong sentence

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: structure.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: So I hope that by hearing this correct sentence structure again and again, you're going to

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: be able to remember if it's "do" or if it's "make."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Let's start by talking about seven expressions using "do."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Everyone loves doing chores.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I dream about doing the laundry.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Doing the dishes is my favorite activity.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Okay, maybe that's not true for you, but here, we're using "do" to talk about this duty,

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: this obligation, this repetitive task.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We use "do" to talk about almost every household chore.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Do the laundry, do the dishes.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Except make the bed.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This is an exception.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: But we often use "do" to talk about those household repetitive chores.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: For more household chores, check out my video, 70 Cleaning Expressions in English, up here.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Number two.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I can't go play a game because I have to do some work, or maybe because I have to do some

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: homework.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: To do work is a common expression.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Actually, I said this to Dan when I was writing this lesson.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: He wanted me to play a game, and I said, "I'm sorry, I can't play the game because I have

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: to do some work," which was writing this lesson.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Number three.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Dan, my husband, plays hockey, and after his game, he often says, "The goalie did a good

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: job, but we still lost."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Or maybe he could have said, "The goalie did a bad job.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: The goalie did a poor job."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Here, we're talking about doing a good job, doing a bad job, doing a poor job.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We're using the word "do" in the past to say "did."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: He did a good job.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: What do you think about this lesson?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Am I doing a good job explaining these expressions?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Number four.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Have you done any exercises recently?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Maybe you might say, "Well, I did some yoga yesterday, and I'm going to do some Pilates

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: today."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This question uses "do" in another verb tense.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Have you done any exercises recently?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This can be a little bit tricky to talk about "do" plus "exercise," because we often just

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: take out "do" completely and say, "Have you exercised recently?"

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This is using "exercise" as the verb.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Have you exercised?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Notice the "-ed" that tells us that this is a verb.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Have you exercised recently?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: But in my original sentence, "Have you done any exercises?"

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This is using "exercise" as a noun, and then "do" is our verb.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: So make sure that you use this correctly.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We don't want to have "do" plus "exercise" as a verb.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We need to only have one verb here.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Have you done any exercises?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Have you exercised?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Number five.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: How are you doing?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I'm doing pretty well.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I'm not doing that hot.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This is a common greeting.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You might hear this all the time.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Maybe you say this a lot.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: To learn some other common greetings and other ways to start sentences, you can check out

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: this link up here.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: How are you doing?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I'm doing great.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I'm not doing that hot.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Wonderful.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Number six.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I always try to do my best.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: "To do my best" is a beautiful expression.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: It means you're not perfect, but you try to do your best.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: If you said this in a job interview, "I always try to do my best every day at work," wow,

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: great.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You're hired.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This is a wonderful way to express that you are a diligent worker, you're a hard worker,

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: and even though you're not perfect, you're going to always do your best.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Number seven.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Please, do something.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Do anything.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Maybe if you have a friend who is single and is always complaining about not going on a

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: date, you might say, "Well, maybe it'd be a good idea if you got out of your house one

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: day.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Maybe you should go to a yoga class.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Maybe you should go for a walk in the park and talk to someone while you're walking your

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: dog.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Just do something.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Do anything."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We often use "do" with these words, "something," "anything."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: And it's not specific.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: "Something" and "anything" is not telling a specific activity, but we often use those

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: together.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You can also use this in a less intense situation.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Maybe if your friend's inviting you to go to a yoga class, you might say, "I can't go

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: to yoga class because I have to do something else."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You're not saying what you have to do.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: It's kind of mysterious.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You're not saying that other activity that you need to do, but you're just saying, "I

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: need to do something else," to do something, do something else.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Now let's go on to "make."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: These are the top 10 expressions using "make," at least according to me.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Number one.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Dan makes oatmeal for us every morning.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I like to make green tea in the afternoon.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We often use "make" with food or drinks, and it's a good way to use this naturally.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Number two.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: If you watch the ad at the beginning of this video, I make some money.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Thanks.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Here, I'm not creating or producing.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I'm not printing the money myself, but here, I'm still acquiring the money.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: So I want to know, when you were in high school, what did you do to make money?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Did you babysit?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Did you walk your neighbor's dog?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Did you do your neighbor's homework?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: What did you do to make money?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Sentence number three.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: It can be tough to make new friends when you move to a new city.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Here, we're using the expression, "make friends."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You're not actually creating your friends like Frankenstein, at least I hope not, but

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: you are acquiring new friends.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: When I think about the friends that I have now, I made one friend at the grocery store,

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I made another friend at yoga class, and I made another friend 10 years ago in college.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: So as an adult, we make friends in a lot of different ways.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Have you ever made a phone call in English?

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: This can be a little bit scary when you do it, but with practice, it gets easier.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: We have a couple expressions we use when we talk about using the phone, but when you are

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: the one dialing the numbers, you are the one who's making a phone call.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: If you want to use some common expressions for phone conversations, then make sure to

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: check out this video up here.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Number five.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Make a suggestion about what kind of lesson you'd like me to make here on YouTube in the

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: future.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I'm asking you to make a suggestion.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Give me some ideas.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Number six.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: When you make a mistake, don't make an excuse.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Just tell the truth.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Here are two for the price of one, "make a mistake" and "make an excuse."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I often hear English learners say, "I did a mistake."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: And to them, I would say, "Yeah, yeah, you did.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: You made a mistake."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: If you want to use "did," you could say, "I did something wrong," but here, this is a

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: beautiful expression that you can use instead with "make."

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I made a mistake.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: And if you make a mistake, don't make an excuse.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: No one likes someone who makes excuses.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I was tired, I was hungry, there was a lot of traffic.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Don't make an excuse, just tell the truth and say you're sorry and move on.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: Number seven.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar
text: I often read reviews to help me make a decision before I buy something.

name: 3 Hour Masterclass: Fluency, Pronunciation & Grammar

text: The next grammar lesson is going to focus on storytelling.
